# Official uv image — see https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pkgs/container/uv
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

# Environment variables recommended by uv
ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1
ENV UV_LINK_MODE=copy
ENV UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=0

# The mounted secrets UV_INDEX_USERNAME and UV_INDEX_PASSWORD.
WORKDIR /app
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \
    --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --locked --no-install-project --no-dev

COPY . /app

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    uv sync --locked --no-dev

# Official Python image — see https://hub.docker.com/_/python
